name: Airlytics Real-Time Flight Streaming Pipeline
description: Consumes raw OpenSky flight pings from Pub/Sub, performs sessionization into flight legs, captures late events, and streams into BigQuery.

parameters.name: input_subscription
parameters.label: Pub/Sub Input Subscription
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub subscription containing normalized flight pings

parameters.name: input_topic
parameters.label: Pub/Sub Input Topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic containing normalized flight pings (if subscription not provided)

parameters.name: late_table
parameters.label: Late Pings BigQuery Table
parameters.helpText: Target table for late events in format project:raw_flights.late_pings

parameters.name: deadletter_table
parameters.label: Deadletter BigQuery Table
parameters.helpText: Target table for malformed records in format project:raw_flights.deadletter_pings

parameters.name: flight_legs_table
parameters.label: Flight Legs BigQuery Table
parameters.helpText: Target table for sessionized flight legs in format project:curated_flights.fact_flight_leg

parameters.name: session_gap_minutes
parameters.label: Session Window Gap Duration (Minutes)
parameters.helpText: Silence gap duration in minutes to split flight sessions (default: 15.0)

parameters.name: allowed_lateness_minutes
parameters.label: Allowed Lateness Duration (Minutes)
parameters.helpText: Allowed lateness in minutes for late data side output (default: 10.0)
